entities.name: Feudal Oath of Fealty
entities.label: Movement
entities.summary: A vassal knelt, placed his hands between his lord's hands, and swore loyalty unto death. In exchange, the lord granted land (a fief) and protection. This ritual — homage and investiture — was the social contract that held medieval Europe together. Breaking the oath was the ultimate crime.
